mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FILE (EXECUTION_ID, STEP_ID, FILE_PATH, ACTION, ACCESS_COUNT, FIRST_AT, LAST_AT) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{stepId}, #{filePath}, #{action}, 1, #{accessedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{accessedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ON CONFLICT (EXECUTION_ID, STEP_ID, FILE_PATH, ACTION) DO UPDATE SET ACCESS_COUNT = AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FILE.ACCESS_COUNT + 1 , LAST_AT = EXCLUDED.LAST_AT
mapper.select: SELECT STEP_ID AS "stepId" , FILE_PATH AS "filePath" , ACTION AS "action" , ACCESS_COUNT AS "accessCount" , FIRST_AT AS "firstAt" , LAST_AT AS "lastAt" FROM AI_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FILE WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} ORDER BY FIRST_AT ASC, STEP_ID, FILE_PATH, ACTION
